cases.question: Can the liability be traced across dates without treating a modeled estimate as independent engineering evidence?

files.instruction: Read the acquisition and closure assumptions.
files.label: Red Wash acquisition and closure source

files.instruction: Follow case 3 and its exact source links.
files.label: Red Wash walkthrough instructions

cases.title: Practice five separate reconciliations
cases.period: January 2027 · base forecast · ARU_GROUP, Atlas Meridian and Willow
cases.situation: Five selected workpapers cover bank clearing, receivables, payables, debt and one asset. They come from different reporting scopes.
cases.question: Do each workpaper’s selected balances tie, and what stronger evidence is missing?

files.instruction: Read the scope and evidence limitations for each case.
files.label: Five-reconciliation instructions

files.instruction: Complete each of the five workpapers in a separate saved copy.
files.label: Five-reconciliation working paper

files.instruction: Compare only after completing your calculations.
files.label: Worked explanations

cases.deliverable: Submit five separate reconciliation conclusions with differences and evidence requests. Do not combine these balances into a trial balance or period close.
cases.limits: These are separate exercises. Willow covers FORT-TEST-RIG only. Modeled bank clearing is not a bank-issued statement; zero differences do not establish completeness.

cases.title: Close one ARU reporting period
cases.situation: One reporting group has an opening trial balance, the complete month’s journal and a closing reporting package. All five reconciliation areas stay within this scope.
cases.question: Can you reproduce the close and distinguish reconciled model balances from externally supported balances?

files.instruction: Start with the period-close instructions and source population.
files.label: ARU period-close instructions

files.instruction: Work from opening balances through activity, reconciliations and statements.
files.label: ARU period-close working paper

files.instruction: Record follow-up evidence without changing accepted source facts.
files.label: Evidence-request tracking guide

cases.deliverable: Submit the balanced closing trial balance, five reconciliation conclusions, proposed adjustments only where supported, and the financial statements. Identify unsupported external evidence explicitly.
cases.limits: January 2027 is a forecast, not an actual completed close. Group reporting is not separate statutory books for every subsidiary. Do not invent aging, vouchers or adjusting entries to make the case look complete.
